slug.description: Permanent human-readable identifier, used in URLs. Fixed at creation. The note with slug '_sidebar' is the wiki's navigation.

title.description: The note's title at creation. The newest title on a noteRevision replaces it.

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the parent wiki record.

main.description: A note within a wiki. The rkey is a TID. Human-readable slug lives in the record body.
